limitations: This review independently ran the 56 new production tests, 15 SDK tests, selected interchange probes and token controls; it audited the full paired-run evidence rather than rerunning all 48 trials or the parent 200-case suite.

The controlled experiment shares storage/hash helpers, validators, publication adapter and sequential adoption glue. It does not demonstrate a concurrent declarative child-result handoff or independently sampled model performance.

The two cached embedding-tokenizer files produce identical IDs for this prompt. Exact local reconstruction does not establish portability across unrelated tokenizers or any inference, billing, quality or KV-cache improvement.
The clean final review is bounded to the inspected sources and stated predicates; it is not proof of arbitrary candidate-code correctness or production sandboxing.
